# PiP Clock

> Minimal fullscreen analog clock designed to be a clean pinned browser tab, especially for Picture-in-Picture workflows during video calls and media playback.

- Canonical URL: https://saadchdhry.github.io/pages/
- Repository: https://github.com/saadchdhry/pages
- Type: single-page web utility
- Primary use case: keep this page pinned so your current tab can move into Picture-in-Picture mode

## Summary

PiP Clock is a no-distraction browser clock page. Its main value is workflow support rather than timekeeping alone: users keep it as the default visible tab so a meeting tab, video tab, or screen-sharing tab can be popped into Picture-in-Picture more easily.

## Best For

- Video calls and conferencing workflows
- Watching video while keeping another app or tab in focus
- Screen sharing setups where a neutral placeholder tab is useful
- Users who want a calm, readable fullscreen clock page

## Implementation Notes

- Single self-contained HTML file
- Inline SVG rendering
- No external dependencies
- Theme and display controls stored in localStorage
